0.0: Dear meat-warrior. Our kingdom faces a crisis of mushtastical proportions. Our own superior fungal forces have been compromised. That is why we are requesting aid from the meated. Will you take the test to prove your power and save our kingdom?

yes.0: The mindless #r#o3300000##k who betrayed our glorious empire now guard the #b#m106020100##k with their awful moldy bodies. I want them punished! Make them into mushstew and bring me #b20 of the #t4000499##k they carry!

no.0: Are you afraid? If you ever get up the courage, let me know.

yes.0: That was amazing. I apologize for doubting your abilities for even a second. Please save our Mushking Empire from this crisis!
